stem.text: Microwaves are emitted from two sources at points X and Y. The two waves meet at point Z. The diagram shows the paths of the two waves.

stem.alt: Points X, Y and Z. A horizontal line with an arrowhead runs from X to Z, and a diagonal line with an arrowhead runs from Y to Z.

stem.text: The waves emitted from points X and Y are coherent.
What is a direct consequence of the two waves being coherent?

A.text: There is a constant difference in the path lengths YZ and XZ.

B.text: There is a constant difference in phase between the two waves at Z.

C.text: There is a constant non-zero difference in frequency of the two waves at Z.

D.text: There is a constant non-zero difference in amplitude of the two waves at Z.
